note: Every third-party source of the own-engines plan (2026-11-14). commit is the pin for its pack: recheck the licence at that commit when the pack starts. bundled_commit is the commit the package's copy, adaptation or summary was made from. Knowledge summarised in references lists them in references (paths under skills/framemotion/) and keeps the source's licence text in integrations/<name>/. Statuses: bundled (byte copy), adapted (rewritten or partial), patterns (techniques only, own code), planned (nothing in the package yet), dependency (installed by npm at the exact version, never bundled; commit is that release's tag).
